thought.text: The production compose fails due to `deploy.resources` cgroup limits incompatible with the container's cgroup v2 threaded mode. The dev compose (documented method 2) started core services but has config bugs. Let me clean up prod and fix the dev compose issues.

reasoning_content:
The production compose has deploy.resources limits which trigger cgroup controller errors. The dev compose worked because it has no deploy.resources. So the production compose fails due to resource limits in this container environment (cgroup v2 threaded mode). This is an infrastructure limitation with `deploy.resources`.

The dev compose worked (started services), only nginx/qgis/tileserver had issues. So let me go back to the dev compose and fix the bugs there — that's a legitimate documented method.

Actually, wait. The issue with deploy.resources is a known docker-in-docker cgroup threading issue. I could work around by removing deploy sections, but that's heavy.

Better: use the dev compose (documented method 2) and fix:
1. nginx mount path bug
2. QGIS heredoc bug
3. tileserver missing mbtiles (needs planetiler generation - huge, likely not feasible but tileserver is optional basemap; it will keep restarting though)

Actually tileserver failing will keep it restarting. Let me check: does the dev compose depend on tileserver? caddy depends_on tileserver. But caddy started. The tileserver just restarts.

Let me revert to dev compose and fix the nginx + qgis issues. These are legitimate fixes to make the documented dev method work.

Actually the task says "If the supplied guide provides multiple documented installation methods, do not declare the installation failed solely because one method fails." and "When feasible, attempt another documented installation method before concluding that the installation cannot be completed."

The dev compose got much further (backend, db, frontend, caddy all up). Only nginx, qgis-server, tileserver had problems. Let me fix them.

Let me first clean up prod.

Then bring dev back up and fix issues:
1. nginx: mount nginx.conf to /etc/nginx/nginx.conf and default.conf to /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
2. qgis: fix heredoc
3. tileserver: needs mbtiles. The config references germany.mbtiles which doesn't exist. For a working install, tileserver isn't strictly needed (frontend uses OSM fallback without PUBLIC_TILE_SERVER_URL). But it will keep restarting. I could generate a small mbtiles with planetiler, but that needs Java. Alternatively set config to not reference a missing file. Hmm.

Let me handle nginx and qgis first as those are core. Then assess tileserver.

Actually, I could also fix the prod cgroup issue. The deploy.resources with `limits` fails due to cgroup v2. Actually the error "cannot enter cgroupv2 /sys/fs/cgroup/docker with domain controllers -- it is in threaded mode" relates to memory limits. Let me try setting the cgroup driver or use systemd... This is an environment limitation.

Let me just go with dev compose which is a documented method and fix its bugs. Let me clean up prod first.
